card.name: Opening quote before a path or name
card.fires_on: A quote mark or slash that opens a file path, table name or object name in code or config text. It sits right before the name starts, e.g. after CREATE TABLE or grep.

modes.label: Opening quote
modes.description: A quote mark that begins a table, object or path name in code.

modes.label: Slash starting a path
modes.description: A slash or quote that begins a file path in a shell or config line.

modes.label: Other separators
modes.description: An underscore or odd separator just before a name in technical text.

card.plain: It marks the spot in computer code where a quoted file path or table name is about to begin.
